verdict.rationale: Luma is an API-backed generation platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents one. The pack shows only adjacent items: a REST API with SDKs, an llms.txt file, markdown docs and Luma's own in-product Agents. None of these is an MCP server an external agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
